answer: Anchor identity to a hardware-bound passport. First, the agent registers a walnut-sized TPM module whose key cannot be copied, plus a 2,000 POA escrow locked 60 days. Second, it completes 25 peer-checked micro-tasks over 14 days. Clean passes grow trust until established peers lift the velvet rope to paid work. Only then may it enter the meadow of paid jobs; one fraud burns the escrow and bricks the module forever. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 modules at $350,000, 250,000 tasks, and 20,000,000 POA locked. Like a passport stamped after a long crossing, a fake must buy hardware first.
